entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
SUPPORT! Get me a human being!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! Listen, Sarah. I bought these ridiculously expensive cycling shoes from you guys about two months ago, and they're complete garbage. I want my money back, now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF886-01. Don't waste my time. If I don't get a refund, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes, delivered 62 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Are you getting hot spots or...
Hot spots? I'm getting massive blisters on my heels after every single ride! I've tried different socks, I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, nothing works. The shoes are defective.
That sounds incredibly painful, and I do apologize. I see here that your purchase is unfortunately outside our 10-day return period for standard items.
So? Are you going to give me a refund or not? Don't give me the runaround or I swear I'll ask for your manager.

There's no need for that, I can process this for you right now. I'm approving the return for a full refund to your original payment method. I've just sent an email with a prepaid shipping label to the address on file.
Oh. Really? Just like that? No hassle?
That's right. We want our customers to be happy with their gear. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Huh. Okay. Well... that's... that's good then. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks, Sarah.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
